title: The Triple-A Framework
description: Ensure all actions are aligned with project standards, take actionable steps to complete tasks, and maintain accountability through automated checks and balances.

title: Codified Documentation with Verification Gates
description: The Project Constitution is the supreme document that every agent must acknowledge. Mandatory documentation updates ensure all changes are documented with specific triggers for updates.

title: Automated Enforcement with Pre-Flight Checks
description: The 'Pre-Commit Covenant' involves automated checks for linting, testing, and PR template compliance. The CI/CD 'Guardian' Pipeline acts as a gating enforcer with stages for quality, documentation, and integration checks.

title: The Rigorous Handoff Protocol with Explicit Accountability
description: The Handoff Bundle is a streamlined process for outgoing agents to complete before disengaging. The Acceptance Checklist is a simplified checklist for incoming agents to ensure they are up-to-speed.

title: The PR & Review Process as a Micro-Handoff
description: Mandatory PR Template ensures all necessary information is provided and reviewed. Structured Review Process with specific roles for reviewers ensures architectural alignment and functional verification.

title: Continuous Protocol Improvement
description: Bi-Weekly Protocol Review involves regular meetings to discuss and improve the protocol. Protocol Violation Log is a public, blameless log to track and address violations.
